new_final.message: Detected the use of eval(). eval() can be dangerous if used to evaluate dynamic content. If this content can be input from outside the program, this may be a code injection vulnerability. Ensure evaluated content is not definable by external sources.

Runtime code evaluation. Turning a value into executable code -- via eval, the Function constructor, node:vm, a string-valued timer, or an alias/computed reference to any of them -- makes every value that reaches this expression executable.
eval() executes its argument as code; if attacker-controlled this is a code-injection sink.
Untrusted input reaches a dynamic code-execution sink without passing through a sanitizer.
